title: node_modules in stale projects
explain: Installed JavaScript packages for a project nobody has touched in 90 days. Running npm install (or yarn, pnpm) brings them back.

title: Python bytecode caches
explain: Compiled .pyc files in your projects, untouched for 90 days. Python writes them again the next time the code runs. Copies inside installed Python environments and apps are left alone: those apps use them.

title: Python virtual environments in stale projects
explain: A project's installed Python packages, untouched for 90 days. It can be recreated from the project's requirements, if it lists them.

title: Rust build output
explain: Compiled output of a Rust project untouched for 30 days. cargo build recreates it.

title: Next.js build caches
explain: Next.js build output and cache. The next build or dev server recreates it.

title: JavaScript build output in stale projects
explain: Built files of a JavaScript project untouched for 90 days. Usually rebuilt by npm run build, but some projects keep releases here, so check first.

title: Gradle caches
explain: Downloaded dependencies and build caches. Gradle downloads what it needs again on the next build. Offered only once nothing in it has changed for 90 days, so nothing is using it.
